biw_news.title: Volvo Outlines Advanced SPA3 Platform Architecture for Upcoming Electric Vehicles
biw_news.summary: Volvo is preparing its radical new SPA3 electric platform to underpin upcoming models like the EX40 successor. This flexible vehicle architecture is engineered to optimize battery integration, structural rigidity, and scalable manufacturing efficiency.

biw_news.title: Fat Fender Garage Re-Engineers Classic 1956 Ford F-100 with Custom Performance Chassis
biw_news.summary: This meticulous restomod project replaces the original framework with an entirely bespoke chassis structure to handle 800 horsepower from a supercharged V8. The engineering overhaul demonstrates advanced aftermarket integration of modern high-strength structural foundations.

biw_news.title: Custom 1985 Ford F-250 SEMA Build Preserves Original Heavy-Duty Chassis Design
biw_news.summary: By retaining the original heavy-duty ladder frame chassis while heavily modernizing the powertrain and twin-traction-beam front suspension, this SEMA build highlights classic truck structural durability. The engineering approach emphasizes the preservation of robust vintage steel frame architectures under high-stress conditions.

biw_news.title: Fat Fender Garage GT/FX Debuts Custom Frame and Modernized Structural Layout
biw_news.summary: Based on a classic Ford F-100, the GT/FX integrates a completely redesigned proprietary chassis and reinforced structural hardpoints to support an 800-hp powertrain. The build showcases advanced frame fabrication techniques tailored for high-output restomod applications.

biw_news.title: Toyota Gazoo Racing Prepares New Celica Platform for WRC Structural Demands
biw_news.summary: Toyota's return to rallying with a competition-spec Celica mandates an extremely rigid body-in-white and specialized roll-cage architecture. The motorsport structural shell will endure severe dynamic torsional loads and high-impact crash scenarios.

biw_news.title: Toyota Confirms GR Celica Competition Shell for Upcoming Rally Program
biw_news.summary: The upcoming rally-spec Celica will feature a heavily reinforced structural safety cell designed to meet rigorous WRC crashworthiness regulations. Engineers are focusing on lightweight composite integration and high-strength tubular framing to withstand severe motorsport abuse.
